title: Experiment ledger record
description: One append-only record of a material tuning or model-drift change (AES-V2.10 / SUE-568). The test this record must pass: it answers "why does this rule/profile/model decision exist?" months later. decision "insufficient_evidence" is a first-class outcome, never a failure to decide. On disk at calibration/ledger/<experiment-id-slug>.json. See docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §6, §9, §7 (model drift) and schemas/MODEL-DRIFT-CONTRACT.md.

kind.description: targeted_tuning: a smallest-justified-change against one layer (AES-V2.5). model_drift: the regression gate run before changing a default model/provider for a role (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §7). Both share this ledger rather than two parallel record types.

hypothesis.description: What was believed wrong and why, stated before the change was made.

failure_evidence.description: The feedback / L1 / corpus record ids that motivated this experiment. Non-empty is enforced by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs, not this schema.

target_layer.description: Must be a declared layer id from editorial/feedback-routing.json (cross-checked by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs against that table, never restated here). For kind model_drift, this is the role/layer whose default model was regression-tested, e.g. "writing" or "calibration".

smallest_change.description: The actual smallest justified change made — not the full set of things that could have been changed.

model_drift.description: Required (checked by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs, not this schema) when kind is model_drift. Per-role approval: a new model may pass for one role and be held for another.

decision.description: insufficient_evidence is a legitimate, expected outcome, not a failure to decide.

calibration_ref.description: The calibration version this experiment produced or fed into, if any. Null when the experiment did not result in a calibration change (e.g. decision revert or insufficient_evidence with no candidate raised).

evaluation_set.description: What was actually rerun. At least one of the three must be non-empty — checked by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs.

cost_result.description: Cost per accepted artifact, not raw call count (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §9).

role_outcomes.description: Per-role approval, e.g. routing PASS, writer HOLD, reviewer PASS — "newer" is not a reason to replace every role at once.
